assertions.subject: Schizoaffective disorder
assertions.quote: requires that a major mood episode be present for a majority of the total disorder’s duration

assertions.subject: Schizoaffective disorder
assertions.quote: after Criterion A has been met

assertions.subject: Delusional disorder
assertions.quote: Criterion A for delusional disorder no longer has the requirement that the delusions must be nonbizarre

assertions.subject: Catatonia
assertions.quote: Criteria for catatonia are described uniformly across DSM-5

assertions.subject: Bipolar I disorder
assertions.quote: The DSM-IV diagnosis of bipolar I disorder, mixed episodes—is replaced with a new specifier "with mixed features."

assertions.subject: Other specified bipolar and related disorder
assertions.predicate: past history of major depressive disorder
assertions.quote: Particular conditions can now be diagnosed under other specified bipolar and related disorder, including categorization for individuals with a past history of a major depressive disorder

assertions.subject: Other specified bipolar and related disorder
assertions.quote: whose symptoms meet all criteria for hypomania except the duration criterion is not met (i.e., the episode lasts only 2 or 3 days instead of the required 4 consecutive days or more)

assertions.subject: Bipolar II syndrome
assertions.quote: too few symptoms of hypomania are present to meet criteria for the full bipolar II syndrome, although the duration, at least 4 consecutive days, is sufficient
